contributionMap.claim: Borghi's question (all zeros of the delta denominator on the negative real axis for every Stieltjes series) is false; complete order-shift classification: orders 1-2 always safe, order 3 safe iff n+beta <= (sqrt(33)-5)/2, order >= 4 never; nonreal zeros are genuine poles.

limitationTriage.limitation: Genuine nonreal poles at every order k>=3 for one fixed measure (Conjecture 6.4); k_0 in Theorem 6.3(2) not effective; cancellation not excluded at large k.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Can an effective quantitative Rouche bound plus a large-k non-cancellation argument close the gap above k=30?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Exact certificate to k=30; the second audit gave an independent exact Rouche certificate of nonreal denominator zeros for every k>=204 (not in the paper; cancellation not excluded); numerical scaled zeros converge to w* of E_mu
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Requires a new effective estimate and a non-cancellation argument beyond the Hankel bound; open problem (i)

limitationTriage.limitation: Explicit all-shift order-four measure only for n=0 and n=1; the same measure fails at n=2 (Corollary 5.2 gives existence for each fixed n without explicit constants).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is there an explicit measure certified for n=2 (or all n)?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Corollary 5.2 (uniform Rouche, proof restored from the first draft); the printed measure has four negative real zeros at n=2, beta=1
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: several hours of search plus symbolic certification
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Existence is proved; an explicit n=2 witness would need a new search and a degree-18 symbolic certificate, and adds no new theorem

limitationTriage.limitation: Weniger-Cizek K_nu family: real-rootedness tested on a finite grid (beta<=5) only; the non-integer Jacobi weights are not real-rooted for every shift (Remark 7.4, beta=20 certificate).
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Do these families give multiplier sequences or satisfy another criterion of Theorem 7.2?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: 975 exact Sturm counts at 4<=k<=8, beta<=5; 180 further exact cases by the second audit; Remark 7.4 reduces all-shift real-rootedness to P_k
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: Open problem (iii); Borghi also reports no proof for the K_nu case

limitationTriage.limitation: Characterisation of measures with E_mu in the Laguerre-Polya class, and whether that suffices for real-rootedness at all large orders.
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Is E_mu in LP equivalent to real-rootedness of Q_k for all large k?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: Necessity direction proved (Corollary 6.2(2)); consistency with multiplier-sequence families noted

limitationTriage.limitation: Other Levin-type weights (Levin's t and u transformations) not treated.
